findings.fp_reason: AJAX endpoint is authenticated-only (wp_ajax_ prefix). Each dispatched operation enforces nonce (check_ajax_referer) and capability (current_user_can). fp_evidence.defense: Three-layer defense: (1) wp_ajax_ hook requires authentication; (2) each AddonHelper method calls check_ajax_referer('caseproof_growth_tools_install_addon', 'nonce') blocking CSRF; (3) each method calls current_user_can('install_plugins'/'activate_plugin'/'activate_plugins').
